title: Compactification transport of the actual kernel trace counit
statement: For a finite commutative coefficient ring A, a proper scheme morphism f:X->Y, a compactification c, a complex B and a trace-diagonal datum d, suppose Rf! is left adjoint to B tensor f* with actual counit given by inverse projection followed by d.trace tensor identity and the left unitor. Then there are t:Rf!_c B->A_Y and an adjunction with the same right adjoint and left adjoint Rf!_c whose actual counit epsilon satisfies PF_c(B,K) followed by epsilon_K = tensor(t,id_K) followed by the left unitor for every unbounded K. Take t to be the canonical compactification comparison followed by d.trace.

proof.text: Transport the supplied adjunction along the canonical comparison rightDerivedLowerShriekIso. Its counit is the comparison at B tensor f*K followed by the old counit. Projection compatibility moves this comparison past projection. Cancel projection with its inverse in the old counit, and combine tensor images of the comparison and trace by functoriality. Define t as the comparison at B followed by the old trace. This proves the actual counit equation for every K.

theorem sfCompactificationKernelTransport
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} [IsProper f]
    (c : Compactification f) {B : DerivedCategoryModule A X} (d : TraceDiagonalDatum A f B)
    (adj₀ : rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f ⊣
      CoordinateTrace.pull A f ⋙ (derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj B)
    (heps : adj₀.counit = SfDiagonalKernel.counit A d) :
    ∃ (t : (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).obj B ⟶
        constantComplex A Y)
      (adj : rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c ⊣
        CoordinateTrace.pull A f ⋙ (derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj B),
      ∀ K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y,
        ((projectionMapOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).app B).app K ≫
          adj.counit.app K =
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).map t).app K ≫
          (derivedTensorLeftUnitor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y K).hom
